correctness.rationale: Distance-regular intersection numbers ensure WL signatures depend solely on d(x,y). Given singleton distance classes through m, a geodesic z with i+j=k splits each m<k<=2m by minimum singleton-color sum, while for k>2m no z lies close to both, and constant sphere counts force a common far signature. Thus P_m refines exactly to P_(2m), and it stabilizes when the far bin contains at most one distance, giving the stated ceil(log2(D-1)). Independently implemented ordered-pair WL and BFS distance bins on C3..C12 and cubes Q1..Q4 verified all intermediate partitions and depths. These are finite checks; proof is for all connected distance-regular graphs.
